Plan your beverage setup

Start with your
business needs.

A useful equipment conversation starts with your menu, expected demand and the practical details of your site.

  1. Define your menu.

    List the drinks you plan to serve, from espresso and milk coffee to filter coffee, tea, chai or hot chocolate.

  2. Estimate demand.

    Share how many people you serve and when demand peaks. This helps frame the capacity discussion.

  3. Check your site.

    Consider counter space and available power and water. We can compare these details with the equipment specifications.

Business enquiries

A few things
to know first.

Quick answers to help you plan your beverage range or equipment enquiry.

Talk with our team →

What products are in the Kaphi range?

The Kaphi range includes roasted coffee beans, filter and instant coffee, premium tea, masala and cardamom tea, a selection of tea bags, hot chocolate and badam milk. Ask us about available packs and blends.

What types of coffee machines can I explore?

The equipment brochure covers the FTC 2.4 filter coffee and tea system and the B2C 2.4 bean-to-cup system. Contact the team to confirm current models, specifications and availability.

How do I choose equipment for my business?

Start with your menu and estimated demand. Then consider counter space, power and water. Share these details with us and we can talk through the listed equipment and specifications.

Where is The Kaphi Solutions based?

Visit us at 1st floor, TheKaphiSolutions, No. 1373, 1st main road, Terige Bhavana Rd, Marilingappa Extension, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560072.

How can I check pricing and availability?

Contact us to ask about current pricing, product pack sizes, equipment models and availability for your business needs.

How can I enquire about products or equipment?

Call +91 98804 91458 or complete the enquiry form below. Continuing opens WhatsApp with your details filled in. Review the message before sending; your details are not stored on this website.
